title: Wilson Green works with Puharich at the Round Table
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Wilson Green works with Puharich at the Round Table, about 1950s at Round Table lab, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: An unnamed researcher tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in the 1950s a man named Wilson Green worked with Andrija Puharich, a scientist who studied psychic abilities, at the Round Table, Puharich's private research lab. The guest says the two of them were trying everything there, and points to Puharich's own journals. It is told as part of the story of how that group came to believe it was in contact with non-human beings.
